අƯ ɪෙශෂ EXTRAORDINARY
(Published by Authority)
PART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
1A –G 044434– 14(05/2025)This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Subsection (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. THE allotments of land described as following names and extents depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. Maha/MDD/2021/685 dated 27.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Burnside, in No. 795 Burnside Grama Niladhari Division, in Palispattuwa Korale North minor division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Medadumbara in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Burniside Estate - Extent: 13.4952 Hectares North and East: Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission; South: Burnside Estate claimed by the
Land Reform Commission and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Burniside Estate - Extent: 5.4184 Hectares North: Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Burnside Estate claimed by the State Plantations Corporation and Road; West: Road and Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Burniside Estate - Extent: 12.3688 Hectares North: Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission; East: Lot D and Burnside Estate claimed by Chanaka Athukorala; South: Burnside Estate claimed by Chanaka Athukorala, Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Burnside Estate of which the claimant is not known; West: Burnside Estate of which the claimant is not known.

2AIIIIII ෙකʣටස ෙකʣටස – – ɼ ලංකා ȝජාතාǦƵක සමාජවාǏ ජනරජෙɏ අƯ ɪෙශෂ ගැසŸ පƴය ɼ ලංකා ȝජාතාǦƵක සමාජවාǏ ජනරජෙɏ අƯ ɪෙශෂ ගැසŸ පƴය – 2025.05.27– 2025.05.27Pൺඋඍ III Pൺඋඍ III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 27.05.2025– GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 27.05.2025
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Burnside Estate - Extent: 12.7936 Hectares North: Burnside Estate claimed by the Land Reform Commission and Burnside Estate claimed by the State Plantations Corporation; East: Burnside Estate of which the claimant is not known and road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Burnside Estate claimed by Chanaka Athukorala, Lot C and Burnside Estate claimed by the land Reform Commission; West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha).

05. Lot ‘E’ – Burnside Estate - Extent: 44.3942 Hectares North: Channel, Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Burnside Estate of which the claimant is not known; East: Burnside Estate of which the claimant is not known and foot path;
South: Foot path and Burnside Estate claimed by land Reform Commission; West: Burnside Estate claimed by land Reform Commission.
K.D. Lൺඅ Kൺඇඍඁൺ, Minister of Agriculture, Live Stock, Land and Irrigation.
